verdict.rationale: Muse is a consumer personal agent used through mobile, Mac, and WhatsApp chat clients, and nothing in the pack documents a headless mode, CLI, or CI integration. Muse working on a schedule after the app is closed is server-side background operation, not user-driven headless or CI automation, so it does not count here. The probes found the API and spec surfaces auth-walled or absent, with no public developer interface.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
